# Tier 4 — Supermedications
These three medications are strong in immediately healing large amounts of an entire group of damage.
However, they only fully metabolize in doses of 3 units or fewer and are not meant to mix with each other. [italic]You should dilute these![/italic]
Additionally, they produce helpful metabolites that may cause overdosing.
[textlink="Medical patches" link="MedicalPatches"] are excellent at administering appropriate doses of these supermedications. Take care to not overdose the patient with the metabolite, though.

## Prerequisites
Aluite is the main precursor to all three T4 medications. It must be cooled in order to mix.
There are multiple ways to get the temperature necessary to make Aluite: - Use Cryostylane to cool your beaker as much as necessary - Use reactions that increase volume to cool your beaker, such as making Dexalin
As the ChemMaster 4000 outputs reagents at the same temperature as your beaker, you may find it useful to first fill your ChemMaster with the ingredients to make Aluite, then to transfer individual reagents to mix in a separate container (such as a jug) so that your beaker does not heat up from Aluite reacting inside of it.
